about_short_description.short_description: Sherloq is a performance marketing platform that integrates artificial intelligence and machine learning with data from websites.

product.name: Sherloq AI Core®
product.description: An AI platform that integrates website and advertising data with IBM Watson to capture and analyze first-party data for marketing optimization.

product.name: Ads Automation with Artificial Intelligence
product.description: A system that uses AI to evaluate and score leads, automating ad campaign optimization based on first-party data without relying on third-party cookies.

product.name: First-Party Data Tools
product.description: Tools that organize, classify, and analyze first-party customer data from multiple sources to improve marketing relevance and customer targeting.

product.name: Enterprise AI Solutions
product.description: Customized AI solutions for enterprises that include data mining, predictive modeling, and integration with marketing and CRM platforms, supporting multiple languages and global operations.

product.name: Automotive Advertising & Marketing Platform
product.description: A platform designed for automotive dealerships to attribute leads accurately, optimize ad campaigns, and provide real-time lead management and marketing intelligence.

product.name: Legal Advertising & Marketing Platform
product.description: A marketing platform tailored for legal firms to manage leads, optimize ad campaigns, and gain insights into client acquisition and market trends.
